scope: Recover the last valid v1 local workbench settings when the v2 value is malformed, while always preferring a valid v2 value and preserving Save/Publish separation.

gap_and_fix.verified_gap: readWorkspacePreferences returned safe defaults immediately when the v2 key contained invalid JSON, even when the legacy v1 key still contained a valid recoverable workbench. This silently discarded previously saved user layout and theme settings.
gap_and_fix.red_reproduction: With v2='{'broken' and valid v1 {version:1,layout:'inspector',theme:'aurora'}, readWorkspacePreferences returned layout='canvas' instead of the last valid legacy layout='inspector'.
gap_and_fix.fix: Try the v2 record first and normalize it only when it is valid JSON object data; if absent, malformed, or non-object, try the v1 record; if storage access is blocked or both records are unusable, return the existing safe defaults. Valid v2 data continues to override stale v1 data. Recovery is read-only; the next explicit user change creates the v2 record. Cache-buster updated to 20261105-workspace-legacy-recovery.
data_and_product_contracts: Recovery does not rewrite either key at startup.
Legacy v1 remains available until the user makes an explicit workspace change.
Valid v2 values always win over stale v1 values.
No Page Model, Save, Publish, or public-renderer write is made.
